title: Pascal Minus-One GCD
headline: Lean/Mathlib formalisation project for the $p \equiv -1 \pmod m$ branch of a restricted binomial-coefficient gcd valuation problem.
description: This project studies $G(N;m)=\gcd\{\binom Nk:0<k<N,\ m\mid k\}$ and targets a formula for $v_p(G(N;m))$ when $p\equiv-1\pmod m$. The repository currently contains a Lean/Mathlib scaffold, a wrapper around Mathlib's Kummer theorem, a decomposed proof plan, and finite Python regression checks; the main theorem is not formally verified and 11 explicit `sorry` placeholders remain.
verification: Not formally verified; 11 explicit `sorry` placeholders remain.
attribution: John Fairfax-Ball maintains the repository and its Lean formalisation/computational scaffold. The repository does not claim novelty; Mathlib supplies Kummer's theorem (`padicValNat_choose`) used in the formalisation.
